f3_program: collection("camp_wonka.campers", "camper", "camp_wonka", source("At camp Wonka, there are 96 campers"))
observe(at("camp_wonka.campers.count", "current"), 96, "count", source("there are 96 campers"))
fraction_of(at("camp_wonka.campers.boys.count", "current"), at("camp_wonka.campers.count", "current"), 2, 3, source("Two-thirds of the campers are boys"))
fraction_of(at("camp_wonka.campers.girls.count", "current"), at("camp_wonka.campers.count", "current"), 1, 3, source("the remaining one-third are girls"))
collection("camp_wonka.campers.want_to_toast_marshmallows", "camper", "camp_wonka", source("50% of the boys want to toast marshmallows and 75% of the girls want to toast marshmallows"))
percent_of(at("camp_wonka.campers.want_to_toast_marshmallows.boys.count", "current"), at("camp_wonka.campers.boys.count", "current"), 50, source("50% of the boys want to toast marshmallows"))
percent_of(at("camp_wonka.campers.want_to_toast_marshmallows.girls.count", "current"), at("camp_wonka.campers.girls.count", "current"), 75, source("75% of the girls want to toast marshmallows"))
observe(at("camp_wonka.marshmallow_allocation.per_camper", "current"), 1, "marshmallow_per_camper", source("each camper gets one marshmallow to toast"))

product_relation(at("camp_wonka.marshmallows.needed.count", "current"), at("camp_wonka.campers.want_to_toast_marshmallows.count", "current"), at("camp_wonka.marshmallow_allocation.per_camper", "current"), source("each camper gets one marshmallow to toast"))
query("value", at("camp_wonka.marshmallows.needed.count", "current"))
assumptions: The phrase "each camper" is scoped to campers who want to toast marshmallows, following the immediately preceding sentence.

f3_program: observe(at("mikaela.tutoring.pay_rate", "current"), 10, "dollar_per_hour", source("$10 an hour"))
rate_relation("mikaela.tutoring.total_earnings.amount", at("mikaela.tutoring.pay_rate", "current"), "mikaela.tutoring.hours", source("Mikaela earns $10 an hour"))
observe(at("mikaela.tutoring.hours", "first_month"), 35, "hour", source("the first month, she tutored for 35 hours"))
offset(at("mikaela.tutoring.hours", "second_month"), at("mikaela.tutoring.hours", "first_month"), 5, "hour", source("in the second month, she tutored 5 hours more than the first month"))
fraction_of("mikaela.personal_needs.spending.amount", "mikaela.tutoring.total_earnings.amount", 4, 5, source("She spent 4/5 of her total earnings on her personal needs"))

remove("personal_needs_spending", "mikaela", at("mikaela.tutoring.total_earnings.amount", "current"), "mikaela.personal_needs.spending.amount", source("She spent 4/5 of her total earnings on her personal needs"))

sum_relation("mikaela.tutoring.total_earnings.amount", "mikaela.personal_needs.spending.amount", "mikaela.savings.amount", source("She spent 4/5 of her total earnings on her personal needs and saved the rest of the money"))
query("value", "mikaela.savings.amount")
assumptions: The phrase "total earnings" refers to earnings from the two tutoring months described.
The requested weekend total requires an unstated calendar cardinality that is absent from the source and F3-v1 ontology.

f3_program: collection("keanu.purchased_fish", "fish", "keanu", source("Keanu bought some fish from the store for his pets"))

transfer("fish_purchase", "keanu", at("store.fish.count", "current"), at("keanu.purchased_fish.count", "current"), "keanu.purchased_fish.count", source("Keanu bought some fish from the store for his pets"))
transfer("give_fish_to_dog", "keanu", at("keanu.purchased_fish.count", "current"), at("keanu.dog.fish.count", "current"), 40, source("he gave his dog 40 fish"))

transfer("give_fish_to_cat", "keanu", at("keanu.purchased_fish.count", "current"), at("keanu.cat.fish.count", "current"), fraction(event_field("give_fish_to_dog", "quantity"), 1, 2), source("He gave his cat half as many fish as he gave to his dog"))
observe(at("store.fish.unit_cost", "current"), 4, "dollar_per_fish", source("each fish cost him $4"))
product_relation("keanu.fish_purchase.total_cost", event_field("fish_purchase", "quantity"), at("store.fish.unit_cost", "current"), source("each fish cost him $4"))
query("value", "keanu.fish_purchase.total_cost")
assumptions: The fish bought for the pets are the fish allocated to the cat and dog.

f3_program: collection("easter_eggs", "egg", "unspecified", source("the Easter eggs"))
fraction_of(at("easter_eggs.blue.count", "current"), at("easter_eggs.count", "current"), 4, 5, source("4/5 of the Easter eggs are blue"))
fraction_of(at("easter_eggs.purple.count", "current"), at("easter_eggs.count", "current"), 1, 5, source("1/5 are purple"))
collection("easter_eggs.five_candy_pieces", "egg", "easter_eggs", source("Half the purple eggs have five pieces of candy each, and 1/4 of the blue eggs do"))
fraction_of(at("easter_eggs.five_candy_pieces.purple.count", "current"), at("easter_eggs.purple.count", "current"), 1, 2, source("Half the purple eggs have five pieces of candy each"))
fraction_of(at("easter_eggs.five_candy_pieces.blue.count", "current"), at("easter_eggs.blue.count", "current"), 1, 4, source("1/4 of the blue eggs do"))
observe(at("easter_eggs.five_candy_pieces.candy_per_egg", "current"), 5, "candy_piece_per_egg", source("Half the purple eggs have five pieces of candy each, and 1/4 of the blue eggs do"))
collection("easter_eggs.one_candy_piece", "egg", "easter_eggs", source("The rest of the eggs only have one piece of candy"))
observe(at("easter_eggs.one_candy_piece.candy_per_egg", "current"), 1, "candy_piece_per_egg", source("only have one piece of candy"))

sum_relation(at("easter_eggs.count", "current"), at("easter_eggs.five_candy_pieces.count", "current"), at("easter_eggs.one_candy_piece.count", "current"), source("The rest of the eggs only have one piece of candy"))
query("percentage_ratio", at("easter_eggs.five_candy_pieces.count", "current"), at("easter_eggs.count", "current"))
assumptions: The phrase "at random" denotes a uniform draw from the Easter eggs.
